result.summary:
Engine track, close-out round 2 (round 1 of this workflow). I picked up where the two agents killed by the container restarts stopped. Their partial work was already in HEAD through the WIP commits (7921394, 32dc769, d1927ab, 17979db): the local-apron glass reflection, the IGU optics, the box-filtered mullions, the sky-only hall daylight, the position-light fixedK, the dev page and the jobs. My working tree held nothing else from them. I kept all of that, ran the app-level checks they never got to, and finished the fixes. No commit.

1. engine-v1, the glass (fixed). I ran the reviewer's A/B in the app at gate:B20,130,1,24, with display sRGB values for the darker 60 % of the verifier's box:
   - Round-3 inputs: (47.2, 45.5, 40.3), B-R -6.9.
   - Same, with the IBL ground set to the paved mean: (56.9, 56.6, 54.3), B-R -2.6. So the IBL ground explains the warm hue but not the brightness.

   Measured term by term, the root cause is five inputs:
   - The pane reflected the sunlit whole-airfield mean ground.
   - The own-shadow term was dead code.
   - The hall's daylight factor was applied to sun + sky.
   - The anti-aliased mullion grid covered about 18 % of the facade instead of 3.9 %.
   - The glass had no body tint.

   The fix: the pane now reflects a local apron (concrete mean plus the facade's own shadow), the IGU optics are tinted, the frame is area-preserving and the hall uses sky light only. Final result: (25.1, 30.3, 27.4), B-R +2.3, G-R +5.2, luminance 29. live.html is 28 and the photo a2.jpg is (31.7, 45.6, 47.1), teal. In the low view the glazing now reads as dark teal glass. The pane no longer depends on the IBL ground (new vs new + paved ground: luminance 27.7 vs 28.9), so no other object's light changed. I calibrated the tint (inferred, no SFO glazing spec found) to the photo's hue, with blue equal to green.
2. engine-v2, the shadeK term (fixed). The overwritten `spec`/shadeK code is gone. shadeK now feeds the local-reflection radiance (kLoc to envAdd) through the environment node.
3. engine-v3, nav lights by day (fixed). Position lights keep their night calibration by day, because a position light has one intensity day and night. In the 38 m close-up the green light went from a saturated 255 white core with 90 green-dominant pixels to max (145, 162, 170) with none: a faint point and no halo, on both high and ultra. The fleet.js records give about 0.65x the 14 CFR 25.1391 minimum; that is routed to the aircraft track.
4. engine-v4, the docs (fixed). closeout §0 was already corrected. The overstated §4.7 row 6 is now marked open; new §4.8 holds the high-tier and ultra evidence for the final lights.js. Round 2 requests are appended to the closeout.
5. engine-v5, the ultra tier (fixed). I ran it once:
   - 0 errors, ready in 166 s.
   - Shadow maps 4096².
   - Texture memory 1,893 MB at ready and 2,234 MB after the views; high is 976-1,152 MB.
   - Peak Chromium RSS 4.0 GB.
   - Headless DPR is 1, so DPR 3 was not exercised.

Every Chromium job ran through flock out/.heavy.lock, one at a time. None of my processes are left running.

dispositions.evidence: Root cause measured term by term (out/engine_r3/close2/close2.json + glass_meas.json, tools/build3/glass_meas.py; dev page out/engine_r3/glassdev/r1-r3). App A/B at gate:B20,130,1,24, verifier's box: round-3 inputs (47.2,45.5,40.3) B-R -6.9 lum 45.5; with the IBL ground set to the paved mean, the requested A/B: (56.9,56.6,54.3) B-R -2.6 lum 56.5. The hypothesis is confirmed for the hue only; the pane stays bright grey. Round-3 reflection term alone: lum 31.8 of 45.5. The hall term is under AgX's black point by day: 0 on the dev page at 745 lx, 2.5 at 4 klx. Fixes in js/three/objects.js: local apron reflection via setupEnvironment envAdd (concrete mean apronAlb 0.321,0.306,0.269 plus own shadow; the result is independent of the IBL ground: new vs new+paved lum 27.7 vs 28.9, so no other object's ambient changed); tinted IGU F0 (0.066,0.102,0.102), T (0.39,0.62,0.62), inferred and calibrated to the hue of the obs photo a2.jpg; area-preserving mullions (gridLineA); renderer3 hall daylight from the sky only (786 lx). Final (ultra run, same old value as high): (25.1,30.3,27.4) B-R +2.3 G-R +5.2 lum 29.0, vs live.html (24.4,28.8,35.0) lum ~28 and photo (31.7,45.6,47.1). Low view old (43.0,45.7,45.2) vs new (24.0,34.1,31.4). Dev page final tint: 130 m B-R +3.5 / G-R +4.4, low view +10.7 / +11.5. Night glazing unchanged apart from thinner mullions. Crops: close2/app_cmp.png, low_cmp.jpg, ac8_full.jpg. Not modelled: reflections of other objects (no SSR).

The overwritten spec.mul(shadeK) is gone. shadeK now enters kLoc = kG x mix(1, shadeK x svf, own), which becomes the env radiance addition envAdd after every spec/ior write (objects.js matId 1). Wall top 15.2 m, from sfo_buildings.json piers h 14.6 + 0.6 m parapet (js/live/terminals.js). renderer3 still computes shadeK each frame (debugInfo shadeK [0.115,0.181,0.311]). §4.8 documents the geometry: shadow 14.7 m, the lowest ~2 m of the glazing band reflects shaded apron.

lights.js put(s, fixed) + renderer3 fixedK keep the aircraft position-light records at the night calibration by day; strobes, beacons, landing/taxi and airfield lights are unchanged. Day close-up ac:a12a82,38,-,6, 13x13 px at the green light (577,326): before (verifier's v_day_ac8.png) max 255 white, 90 green-dominant px; after max (145,162,170), mean (97,113,125), 0 green-dominant px on high (close2/c2_day_ac8.png) and ultra (ultra/u_day_ac8.png); zoom close2/nav_zoom.png. Night unchanged (fixedK = 1 at night). The record intensities (26/13 cd vs the 14 CFR 25.1391 minimum 40/20 cd) are routed to the fleet.js owner (closeout R2.2).

open_questions: Owner: should the IBL ground (the light every object gets from below) use the concrete mean (0.321, 0.306, 0.269) instead of the whole-airfield mean? That is +6 / +11 / +28 % per channel. The glass no longer depends on it. Changing it needs a full re-verification pass.

Aircraft track (js/aircraft/fleet.js): the position-light records give 26 / 13 cd against the 14 CFR 25.1391 minimum of 40 / 20 cd. Meeting it needs i of about 63 / 38, and that also changes live.html at night.

The pier mullion finish is unverified. a2.jpg shows light aluminium mullions on Boarding Area G, while live3 draws dark grey metal inherited from the old shader. It was not changed on the strength of one photo.
The glass reflects only sky and ground. Bridges, aircraft and other buildings are not reflected (no screen-space reflections); not tried on llvmpipe.
Not checked: the WebGPU backend (no adapter in the sandbox) and ultra's DPR 3 (headless DPR is 1). The lead still has to rebuild and republish the phone artifact after the commit.

result.summary:
Bridges round 1, resumed after the third container restart. I kept the killed fixer's work in js/live/gates.js where it held up: the departure API, segPeak timing, and the SFO Museum footprints (the outlines the 3-D ITB and domestic assets are built from) treated as clearance. I fixed what did not hold up:

- **Start-up speed.** The sampled Museum-outline test made start-up 13.9 s instead of 0.8 s, and 3,387 plans 147 s instead of 4 s. It is now an exact test (edge grid plus segment clipping): 0.6 s and 5 s, with the same results.
- **VDGS.** Facade units are mounted on the drawn wall again, and every unit or post must also clear the Museum outlines and the sky bridges.
- **Rest poses after a rotunda shift.** Moving the stow with the rotunda put B15 L1's cab in B16 L1's B744 path, so the rest cab stays at the data's stow and the pivot sits at the model's retraction on the same line.
- **Stair side.** Penalties are now weighted by how long a pose lasts. Before, G7 L1's stair rested inside G7 L2's drum.

New work:
- **bridges-v1:** a departure API that keeps the datasheet rates: `undockEarly` / `redock` / `pushClearEta` / `undockEta` / `dockEta`, documented at the top of bridges_closeout.md under "Round 2 API for realtime", with integration notes.
- **bridges-v3:** the clip is measured exactly and labelled as a known data clip (`b.ownClip`).
- **bridges-v7:** belt loaders are set per family and per cargo door from the published sills, raised to meet the rendered skin. Catering boxes are lifted to the door-2 floor, and `acHit` now tests the swept tailplane planform instead of a rectangle.
- **bridges-v9:** stale comments corrected.
- **orch-1:** root cause traced to the stand data; the exact data change is written in static_closeout.md §5 and checked.
- **Docs:** a Round 2 section in bridges_closeout.md, and the static data request in static_closeout.md §5.

Verification: one 800x500 llvmpipe snapshot render at B26 (under the heavy lock) had no page errors and showed nothing visibly wrong. Nothing is committed, and every process I started has finished.

dispositions.evidence: The gates.js side is done. New calls `undockEarly(G, now)` (retraction on the earliest departure signal, at the datasheet rates), `redock` (undo a false signal; also triggered by `setOccupant` with the same type and pose), `pushClearEta` (the only hold the body needs: p50 1.0 s, p99 4.7 s, max 25.2 s over 2,883 dockings), `undockEta` and `dockEta`. `hurryUndock` stays at the sheet's maximum rates. The contract test found 0 pose jumps. The stale comments at :38 and :1003 are corrected. The API and integration steps are at the top of bridges_closeout.md. The orphan-frame replay cannot change until realtime replaces the 6 s HOLD_CAP / bridgeK hold in traffic.js with pushClearEta / undockEarly, which is their file.

This is stand data. The same 12 observed (bridge, type) pairs are refused after this round as before (bcheck2: A1 / A2 L2 dock_types_out, A6 / A11 upper extension, F5 L1 slope, F11 L2 path, F15 L1 fixed walkway, G7 / G8 L1 E75L slope). Restated in static_closeout.md §5 item 2 and bridges_closeout §1.1, 1.5, 1.6, 1.9.

The clip is now listed as a KNOWN DATA CLIP rather than an accepted junction: `b.ownClip` holds the exact plan overlap per bridge (A12 L1 0.32 / 0.47 m2 in 37/37 poses, F5 0.18, F14 0.40, F17 0.45 / 0.46, F19 0.45 / 0.52, F21 0.56), and the fixedHit comment says so. The cause is the data: the poses fold back to 41-45 deg from the bridge's own walkway. Requested in static_closeout.md §5 item 1 (check the last walkway segment and the rotunda against NAIP). Refusing these poses instead would leave observed types undocked.

The departure level is an unsourced inference. Docked slopes steeper than 1:12 / 1:8: 975 / 388 -> 969 / 386 of 3,286; observed types 125 / 39 of 605, unchanged; HrPinned on 108 bridges. Sourced departure levels or rotunda heights are requested again in static_closeout.md §5 item 3.

Stow positions are static data. gates.js draws stow as given, except where a rotunda moved off the Museum outline shortens the rest tunnel below the retraction (6 bridges, pivot 0.1-0.8 m out on the same line; the exact stows are in static_closeout.md §5). Not re-measured against OSM: Overpass was down.

`segPeak` times each segment by the cab pivot's exact peak speed instead of its mean. In hurry_peak.mjs, over 3,286 plans: peak pivot 0.45 m/s and peak drive column 0.45 m/s (were 0.536 and 0.486), plans over 0.455 m/s 0 (was 172). Durations 16-91 s, p50 27 s; cab at most 145 deg/min, lift at most 1.09 m/min.

Belt loaders now use per-family, per-door published sills (`BELT_PUB`, 737 NG ACAP lines 1327-1442, A321 AC lines 3869-3874), raised to at least 0.3 m above the rendered lowest skin. The conveyor-to-skin gap falls from 0.38 m to at most 0.024 m. Catering boxes are lifted to the door-2 floor (`cateringFloor` / `cateringBoxes`), and `acHit`'s tailplane is now the swept, tapered planform. Mesh-sampled gse.mjs: catering 11 -> 26 (A) and 0 -> 28 (B), belt loaders 79 / 138 unchanged, 0 conflicts. Re-seating the 737 model at the published sill is still the aircraft track's job; the conveyors will then drop to the published values by themselves.

Not a bridge defect. b19.mjs checks every bridge involved (B19 at rest and docked to every type it serves; G5 L1 / L2, A2 L1 / L2 and F20 L1 at rest) against the arriving stand's accepted types swept straight along the lead-in from 80 m back to the stop, with 0 m margin: all clear. The reported positions were 4.4 m (B20), 4.9 m (G5) and 12.3 m (A2) off the lead-in. Handed to realtime (trace these arrivals, keep the body on the lead-in) and tools (tapered nose in invariants.mjs), bridges_closeout R2.2.

The setOccupant / extension / hurryUndock comments are corrected (door height only within 1:4, then the settle; measured 16-91 s; the hold is pushClearEta). The inferences remain: 158 dockings beyond the operational extension (max +1.02 m, was 189 / +1.19 m) and 19 that need the inferred optional 185 deg cab. Re-requested in static_closeout.md §5 item 5.

Root cause is stand data, not the docking path or gates.js. A10 L1's OSM rotunda (a roof trace with relief lean) is 0.77 m from the SFO Museum Boarding Area A outline, so check_stands' 2.9 m tunnel grazes it 2.6-6.5 m out (0.85 m2); the cab is clear. On the gates.js side, drums and moving parts now clear the Museum outlines exactly: 0 rest / docked / path poses inside (were 1 / 88 / 88) and 0 drums overlapping (were 41), with 31 rotundas moved 0.08-1.37 m. The exact data change (31 rotundas, 6 stows) is in static_closeout.md §5, checked with check_stands on a copy: ISSUES 1 -> 0, nothing new. tools/sat/check.py on the real data still shows the A10 ISSUE until the static track applies it.
